254:t_005:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Only about a third of us are here, though.」

254:t_005:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「So both $n and Miss $$スズネ$$ are safe!」

254:t_005:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes...! We're both fit as a fiddle!」

254:t_005:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is even more energetic than usual, if anything.」

254:t_005:5.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Maybe something happened inside the cramped cockpit of $$ジェニオン$$.」

254:t_005:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You should ask $$いぶき$$ about that stuff.」

254:t_005:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「Now, now, $$いぶき$$. Let's just call this a happy occasion, since $n and the others have been found.」

254:t_005:11.en:
$$青山$$
「Right? We got thrown somewhere out in space, and they're still this carefree.」

254:t_005:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Well, first let's make sure Miss $$スズネ$$ is all right.」

254:t_006:1.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$竜馬$$... You're so kind to Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_006:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Kind of looks like special treatment, huh.」

254:t_006:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What are you talking about, you guys...! I'm doing this as her coworker...」

254:t_006:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But, $$竜馬$$... you already quit as the janitor at $$陣代高校$$, didn't you?」

254:t_006:7.en:
$$くらら$$
「Now... how will he turn this situation around?」

254:t_006:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「So in the end, it's Big Bro $$竜馬$$'s favor-erotism!」

254:t_006:9.en:
$$木下$$
「I believe the word is favoritism, $$勝平$$.」

254:t_006:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Qu-Quit acting like a bunch of kids!」

254:t_006:17.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even $$流竜馬$$, the Demon, is bombing nonstop.」

254:t_006:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is this okay...? Carrying on like this...」

254:t_006:19.en:
$n
「That's enough of this. The $$サイデリアル$$ are still out there.」

254:t_006:21.en:
$$さやか$$
「That's surprising... Knowing $n, I figured he'd get grumpy if $$竜馬$$ got close to Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_006:22.en:
$$ボス$$
「I guess he's grown up too.」

254:t_006:23.en:
$n
「$$竜馬$$ isn't the only one who left $$陣代高校$$.」

254:t_006:26.en:
$$メール$$
「He just dropped the 'Miss' like that!」

254:t_007:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's your punishment for teasing an adult! I'll give you a good thrashing later!」

254:t_007:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... I'll be backing you up. So don't you dare die!」

254:t_007:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh! A friendship that transcends generations, spoken through fists!」

254:t_007:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「A friendship blooming between two men fighting over a beautiful female teacher... I'm so fired up...!」

254:t_007:6.en:
$n
「There's no point saying anything to those two...」

254:t_007:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Everyone...! The $$サイデリアル$$ are still out there! Don't let your guard down!」

254:t_007:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$タケル$$. If it weren't for you, this would have just kept on dragging.」

254:t_007:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, intercept the $$サイデリアル$$ and...」

254:t_007:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Before that, take evasive action, quickly.」

254:t_008:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Watch out! Here they come!」

254:t_009:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Of all places to run into them again...!」

254:t_009:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It is theorized that the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s originally came to Earth from outer space.」

254:t_009:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So you're saying this time, we may have stepped into their habitat.」

254:t_009:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In short, we're the trespassers... the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, so to speak.」

254:t_009:5.en:
$$ギミー$$
「This is no time for stupid jokes, Mr. $$田中$$!」

254:t_009:6.en:
$$ダリー$$
「They've completely marked us as their targets!」

254:t_009:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「That giant one... when it comes to gross, it's a match for the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

254:t_009:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We just brush off the sparks that fall on us. Right, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

254:t_009:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Of course. Wherever this is, we aren't here to become their food.」

254:t_009:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「Roger! We'll make them regret coming at us!」

254:t_009:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Us getting teleported here is the end of your luck!」

254:t_009:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! We met in this vast universe, so it's fate! I'll fight you until one of us drops!」

254:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Is that all you've got, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Don't make me laugh!」

254:t_010:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$竜馬$$ is fired up even more than usual.」

254:t_010:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Maybe he's seriously trying to look good in front of Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_010:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「No... that's not it... He senses a premonition of the enemy.」

254:t_010:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Looks like they're about to make their appearance.」

254:t_011:0.en:
$$ナオト$$
「There you are, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

254:t_011:1.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「There are giant types too, but not that many of them! We can take them!」

254:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No...! These guys are nothing but small fry...!」
